name: Logicrays Easy Coming Soon Page
author: LogicRays Technologies

sections.description:
Quickly set up a maintenance or coming soon page and inform visitors your website is under maintenance.

Arbitrary section 1
sections.installation:
1. Upload Zip file lecsp-coming-soon to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
How do I enable the Coming Soon / Maintenance page?

Go to the “LR Coming Soon” settings page in your WordPress admin dashboard, select “Yes” under the “Enable Maintenance Mode” option, and click “Save Changes”. To disable it and make your site public again, switch the option to “No” and save your changes.

Can I schedule maintenance mode to start and end automatically?

Yes. Set the “Timer” option to “ON” and select your desired Start Date, End Date, and exact time (hours, minutes, seconds, and AM/PM). The plugin uses your WordPress site’s timezone settings to automatically enable and disable maintenance mode at the specified times.

How does the countdown timer work?

When scheduling is active (with the Timer option set to ON), a live countdown timer is displayed on the plugin settings page. It shows the time remaining until maintenance mode is automatically activated (if scheduled for a future date) or deactivated (if it is currently active).

Can I use a background video instead of a static image?

Yes. Set the “Background Type” option to “Video” and upload your MP4 video file directly from the WordPress Media Library. If you prefer a static background, set the option to “Image” and upload a background image instead.

Who can access the website when maintenance mode is active?

Logged-in administrators and users with administrative capabilities can access and browse the front end of the site normally. Public visitors and non-logged-in users will see the Coming Soon / Maintenance page.

Can I customize the text, colors, and layout of the Coming Soon page?

Yes. You can customize the page title, main heading, heading text color (using the color picker), and the main content text through the WordPress editor.

How do I add my social media links to the page?

Set “Social Media” to “Yes” and enter links to your social media profiles (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest, Google+, and LinkedIn). The corresponding social media icons will automatically appear at the bottom of the Coming Soon page.

Will search engines index my site while it is in maintenance mode?

You can control this behavior using the “Robots Meta Tag” option. Selecting “noindex, nofollow” instructs search engines not to index the page, while selecting “index, follow” allows search engines to index it.
sections.changelog:
1.4

  • Compatibility: Fully tested and compatible with WordPress 7.1, including persistent toolbar support for admin bar status indicators across post and site editors.
  • Fix: Resolved Array to string conversion issue with the robots meta tag setting in PHP 8+.
  • Fix: Fixed social media toggle logic check so setting “Social media?” to “No” correctly hides social icons.
  • Fix: Fixed potential undefined array key warnings for heading text color when options are unconfigured.
  • Accessibility: Added translatable alt attributes to all social icon image elements.
  • Performance: Optimized admin asset enqueuing so media picker and date/color scripts only load on the plugin settings page.
  • Enhancements: Updated maintenance page response headers to use native WordPress status_header(503), nocache_headers(), and Retry-After headers for optimal SEO crawler handling.

1.3

  • New: Added scheduled maintenance mode with start date and end date support.
  • New: Users can now set a specific start date and end date (DD/MM/YYYY format) to control when maintenance mode is active.
  • New: Added time picker (hours, minutes, seconds, AM/PM) for both start and end datetime fields, powered by Flatpickr.
  • New: Maintenance mode automatically enables at the configured start date and time.
  • New: Maintenance mode automatically disables at the configured end date and time — no manual action required.
  • New: Timer toggle (ON/OFF) added to enable or disable the scheduling feature independently.
  • New: Site timezone is respected when calculating start/end timestamps, using WordPress timezone settings.
  • New: Admin bar now shows maintenance mode status for quick visibility.
  • New: Countdown timer displayed on the settings page showing time remaining until maintenance mode enables or disables.

1.2

  • New: Added background video support for the coming soon / maintenance page.
  • New: Users can now choose between a background image or a background video via the new “Background Type” option.
  • New: Upload background video (MP4) directly from the WordPress media library.
  • New: Video preview shown in the admin settings after upload.
  • New: Option to remove the uploaded background video.
  • New: Settings fields are dynamically shown or hidden based on the selected background type (image vs. video).

1.1

  • Fix: Front side social icon display issue fixed.
